title: Resteasy  Reactive -  stream cannot be null
body:
**Describe the bug**

I am right now starting a new quarkus project on 1.11.0.Final. I wanted to try out the new Resteasy reactive. However, on dev mode launch I get an exception which I can't fix myself.

If I switch to Resteasy Classic, no such exception occurs.

**Expected behavior**
Switching between Resteasy Reactive and Resteasy Classic should be as painless as possible. No random exceptions should occur because of this switch.

**To Reproduce**

Link to a small reproducer (preferably a Maven project if the issue is not Gradle-specific).

Or attach an archive containing the reproducer to the issue.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start the database with docker-compose up -d
2. Download the reproducer: 
[settingsservice.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/5826448/settingsservice.zip)
3. start quarkus in dev mode: mvn clean compile quarkus:dev
4. Exception from above happens
5. Now, simply replace the quarkus-resteasy-reactive-jackson extensions with quarkus-resteasy-jackson (in the settingsservice-service modul)
6. start quarkus in dev mode again
7. This exception does not occur

**Configuration**
```properties
quarkus.http.cors=true

quarkus.datasource.db-kind=mariadb
quarkus.liquibase.migrate-at-start=true

%dev.quarkus.hibernate-orm.log.sql=false
%dev.quarkus.datasource.username=root
%dev.quarkus.datasource.password=root
%dev.quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url=jdbc:mariadb://localhost:3400/settings

```
